offering.name: Business Intelligence & Dashboards
offering.tagline: Self-service dashboards your business teams actually use.
offering.summary: design and delivery of governed, self-service dashboards and reporting that give business users answers without waiting on IT
typical_requirements: Replace static reports with interactive dashboards
Let business users answer their own questions
Agree on shared, governed metric definitions
Enforce role-based access to sensitive data
integrations: the data warehouse or source systems
differentiators: Governed metrics prevent duplicate, conflicting definitions
Designed for adoption — business users, not just analysts
offering.pricing_model: Fixed price by workstream, invoiced on milestones
success_metrics: static reports replaced by interactive dashboards
a shared, governed set of metric definitions in use

snippets.understanding: Leaders wait on IT for static reports, and different teams define the same metric differently. You want governed, self-service dashboards people trust and actually use.
snippets.solution: We will deliver executive and operational dashboards on a governed set of metric definitions, with self-service exploration, drill-down, and scheduled exports — designed for adoption by business users, with role-based access to sensitive views.

product_line.name: Data & Analytics
product_line.summary: Data platforms, pipelines, and analytics that turn scattered data into decisions.
